name: 関心条件を検索結果へ反映する進行案内
prompt:
Create one Japanese loading/progress card on a clean white canvas, matching the supplied source crop proportions (1080:603, about 1.79:1).

Reference priority:
1) The original progress-state crop controls the card footprint, top-center heart mark, centered status copy, muted interest label, spacing and bottom progress bar. Preserve the heart contour and its nested line structure from the source.
2) The Japanese preview controls the exact Japanese copy, rounded card outline and Lighthouse green accent.

Use a single white rounded rectangle card with a very thin pale-gray outline. Near the upper center, draw the same nested open-line heart mark as the original (retain its double contour and lower-right open/tapered strokes) recolored in #2D8F5E. Center the exact message “選んだ関心に合わせて、検索結果を更新しています。” below it, wrapping naturally to two balanced lines in a Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif, Regular 14/20, near-black gray. Below that show the muted preference “＋ ベーカリー” in light gray. Along the bottom edge, use a very thin pale-gray progress track with a short green segment at the far left, matching the preview.

Keep the card sparse, calm and vertically balanced with generous white space, as in the references. Do not add a spinner, illustrations, extra text, page header, phone frame, status bar, buttons, background decorations or watermark. Preserve the exact heart silhouette and stroke structure while applying the preview's green.
reviewNotes: 表示とコピーを確認済み
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
